The 8808A needs a half-hour warm-up with the cover on before verification (Calibration Manual, p. 1-9 / chapter 3). The specifications are only valid in the slow (5-1/2 digit) rate, which the program selects.

run_5522A_all_points.caution: Never use the calibrator as a zero source. The program does not turn its output on for these points.
facts: Zero offset, DC volts, 200.0 mV range (input shorted)
steps: Set up the input
Disconnect the calibrator. Fit the low-thermal 4-wire short (Fluke PN 2653346, Calibration Manual Table 3-1) across INPUT HI / LO and SENSE HI / LO. The calibrator stays in STANDBY.
run_5522A_all_points.text: Setup: Shorted input (zero offset)
run_5522A_all_points.title: Zero offset: physical setup required

run_5522A_all_points.caution: Never use the calibrator as a zero source. The program does not turn its output on for these points.
facts: Zero offset, DC current, 200.0 µA range (input open)
steps: Set up the input
Leave the current inputs (mA and 10 A terminals) OPEN with nothing connected. The calibrator stays in STANDBY.
run_5522A_all_points.text: Setup: Open current input (zero offset)
run_5522A_all_points.title: Zero offset: physical setup required

run_5522A_all_points.caution: Never use the calibrator as a zero source. The program does not turn its output on for these points.
facts: Zero offset, DC current, 2.000 A range (input open)
steps: Set up the input

Insert a test lead into the 10 A terminal and leave its free end OPEN (nothing connected to the other end of the lead). The meter detects the current input jack itself and only allows the 2 A and 10 A ranges when a test lead is in the 10 A jack (Users Manual p. 3-14, Automatic Input Terminal Detection). The calibrator stays in STANDBY.

steps: Why
5522A: 330 V to 1020 V is specified 45 Hz to 10 kHz only (5522A Operators Manual, Detailed Specifications, AC voltage, printed p. 1-12). The manual uses a 5725A amplifier.
Standard

Disconnect the calibrator. Connect your own standard to the meter as for Voltage and frequency inputs (Calibration Manual Table 3-1 names a 5725A amplifier for 750 V and a Fluke 271 function generator for frequency) and apply 750.0 V at 20.00 kHz. Use a standard with enough accuracy for the limits.
Wiring

steps: Standby
The calibrator is put in STANDBY before you rewire.
Wiring

4-wire (Figure 3-2): calibrator NORMAL HI / LO to INPUT HI / LO and the calibrator SENSE HI / LO to the meter SENSE 4W HI / LO. Turn the calibrator's external sense (EX SNS / EXT SENSE) ON at its front panel.
Annunciator
The program has selected the ohms function with 4W. Confirm the 4W annunciator is lit on the meter display (the 8808A cannot report the wire mode over RS-232).

warmup_refused.text:
The 8808A needs a half-hour warm-up with the cover on before verification (Calibration Manual, p. 1-9 / chapter 3). The specifications are only valid in the slow (5-1/2 digit) rate, which the program selects.

Has the meter been on for at least half an hour?
warmup_refused.title: Warm-up
